text.arabic_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ وَلَا هُدًۭى وَلَا كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّنِيرٍۢ

words.gloss_range: opening connector with continuation and renewal force, fused into the partitive launch
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as continuation rather than an isolated restart. It joins the preceding certainty with another human-type entry, while its fusion into the opening partitive phrase makes the catalogue begin in one compact motion.

topics.headline: continuation plus renewed catalogue entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah continues the prior discourse while beginning a fresh specimen in the human catalogue.
topics.reason: The ayah-initial connector is licensed as coordination/resumption, and the surrounding profile marks the repeated human-type formula.

topics.headline: fused compact launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the connector as part of a compact opening phrase, not as a detached marker.
topics.reason: The written and recited opening binds the connector to the following partitive frame.

words.gloss_range: partitive extraction from the human collective, fronted as the ayah's classificatory frame
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:minā}}) extracts a type from the human collective before the action is named. The fronted partitive frame makes the disputant a specimen within humanity, and the recurrence of the same opening shape from 22:3 turns the ayah into a second catalogue entry rather than a universal claim about all people.

topics.headline: subset extracted from humanity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disputant is a type drawn from people, not all people and not an outside class.
topics.reason: Local case government makes the following collective noun genitive under the preposition, licensing partitive extraction.

topics.headline: population frame before action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah classify the source population before describing the behavior.
topics.reason: The fronted prepositional phrase opens the nominal construction before the relative clause supplies the action.

topics.headline: repeated catalogue formula from 22:3
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the opening as a reprise of the human-type formula from 22:3, now expanded after the certainty of 22:7.
topics.reason: The bundle explicitly marks the classification refrain as a repeated formula anchored at 22:3.

words.gloss_range: definite human collective as the source set from which a disputing type is drawn
words.root_gloss_range: human-social and perception/familiarity range, with contested forgetfulness pressure treated cautiously as discourse background
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:an-nāsi}}) is the governed source set, not the subject of the disputing verb. Its definiteness makes the extraction broad: a recognizable type is drawn from humanity as a public social collective, while the human root pressures of sociability, perception, and contested forgetfulness sharpen the irony of an epistemically unsupported disputant. The assimilated article and m/n sounds bind the partitive phrase audibly, so the typological opening is heard as one compact unit.

topics.headline: definite collective as source set
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices humanity as the broad source field from which one type is extracted, not as the actor of the verb.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and genitive under the preceding partitive preposition.

topics.headline: social-perceptive human pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the disputant as a public human specimen whose failure is pointed because humans are framed as social and perceptive beings.
topics.reason: The local word remains the collective people; derivational and contested human-root pressures are retained as image pressure, not as a replacement for the selected noun.

topics.headline: formulaic human typology with nasal binding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the collective noun helps make the ayah typological and that the opening sounds bind the source phrase tightly.
topics.reason: The formulaic human-type construction and recitational nasal binding both support the compact opening classification.

words.gloss_range: open relative subject, singular specimen defined by the following act rather than by name or group
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) turns the extracted group into an open relative specimen: whoever fits the action. It occupies the subject position carried into the following verb, so the person is known by the act of disputing rather than by title, lineage, or a fixed historical label. After the certainty and raising scene of 22:7, this pronoun is the grammatical point where the discourse becomes a surface social specimen.

topics.headline: whoever defined by action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is repeatable typology: the actor is whoever matches the behavior.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is the subject carried into the relative clause and is defined by its predicate action.

topics.headline: new social actor after prior scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the boundary move from prior cosmic assertion into a social portrait concentrated in one actor.
topics.reason: The relative-clause architecture makes the action the identity center of the new social specimen.

words.gloss_range: ongoing reciprocal disputation, overtly argumentative and routed into a topical divine-domain frame rather than a direct object
words.root_gloss_range: argument/contending range colored by twisting, braiding, and struggle imagery; local Form III selects reciprocal verbal contention
words.prose: {{ar:يُجَٰدِلُ}} ({{tr:yujādilu}}) makes disputation the actor's ongoing identifying behavior. Form III gives it a reciprocal, adversarial back-and-forth, and the root image of twisting lets the argument feel like strands being worked against one another. The verb takes a topical prepositional domain rather than a direct object, so the argument is located concerning God, then judged by its lack of knowledge, guidance, and illuminating book. The repeated construction from 22:3 returns here with a larger inventory of missing warrants, and after the certainty of 22:7 the long medial sound of the verb lets the arguing feel extended before the clipped privation chain closes it down.

topics.headline: imperfect action defines the person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices disputing as the person's characteristic posture, not a single completed event.
topics.reason: The imperfect third masculine singular verb agrees with the open relative subject and supplies the relative clause's identity center.

topics.headline: reciprocal contention with twisting image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the disputation as adversarial verbal twisting, while local morphology keeps the selected sense as reciprocal argument.
topics.reason: Root-image evidence supports twisting pressure, and Form III licenses reciprocal contention; physical braiding or armor is image pressure, not the local action.

topics.headline: prepositional topic rather than direct object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb routes the dispute into the divine domain instead of making God a patient acted upon.
topics.reason: The local frame has no direct object and is completed by prepositional complements.

topics.headline: theocentric dispute without warrants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the speech act to the following epistemic deficit and to the reprise of the 22:3 disputation pattern.
topics.reason: The ayah repeats the 22:3 construction but expands the deficiency into three missing supports.

topics.headline: extended arguing against compressed privations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the expansive disputing verb set against the shorter denied supports and sees it answer the certainty just asserted.
topics.reason: Sound and boundary rows converge on the same local effect: live disputation follows sealed certainty and then meets a depleted support inventory.

words.gloss_range: topical-concerning preposition marking the divine name as the domain of dispute, not spatial containment
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) selects the domain of the argument. In this verb frame it functions as concerning or within the topic of God, not as ordinary spatial containment, and it closes its complement before the later lack phrase begins. Because the prepositional unit flows directly into the divine name, the disputed domain is named immediately before the ayah turns to the unsupported means.

topics.headline: dispute-domain preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the dispute as entering a divine topic-domain rather than simply taking a direct object.
topics.reason: The preposition is the licensed complement of the disputing verb and governs the divine name.

topics.headline: scope closes before lack phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah name the disputed domain immediately before evaluating the unsupported means.
topics.reason: Local syntax separates the dispute-topic complement from the following manner or support phrase.

topics.headline: stronger than detached aboutness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the preposition choice as more invasive than detached commentary, while the local sense remains topical.
topics.reason: The contrast with a possible aboutness marker is useful as pressure, but local grammar only requires a topical complement.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name governed as the topic/domain of unsupported disputation
words.root_gloss_range: deity, worship, dependence, refuge, and bewilderment range; local form fixes the unique divine name rather than a generic deity noun
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) is the governed divine topic of the dispute, not the agent of the verb. The proper-name form fixes the referent as God rather than a generic deity, while worship, refuge, and bewilderment pressures make the unsupported argument target the very one toward whom dependence should turn. The same name moves from asserted divine agency in 22:7 to disputed topic in 22:8.

topics.headline: God as dispute topic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the argument is explicitly theological: God is the topic-domain being disputed.
topics.reason: The divine name is genitive under the topical preposition attached to the disputing verb.

topics.headline: proper name blocks generic deity reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the dispute is not about deity in the abstract but about the proper divine referent.
topics.reason: The local form is a definite proper noun, not an indefinite common noun.

topics.headline: worship-refuge-bewilderment pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the impropriety of arguing unsupported about the one associated with worship, refuge, and bewildering dependence.
topics.reason: Derivational pressure survives as theological color, while the local lexical item remains the proper divine name.

topics.headline: same name from agent to disputed topic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sharp boundary shift: the God asserted in 22:7 becomes the topic of unsupported disputation in 22:8.
topics.reason: Surrounding discourse repeatedly names God and the boundary row marks the role shift from divine agent to disputed topic.

words.gloss_range: proclitic preposition attaching the no-knowledge phrase as manner, circumstance, or instrument of the disputation
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) fastens the first lack phrase to the disputing verb. It lets the absence of knowledge function both as circumstance and as a cutting instrument-like description: the argument proceeds with, or by means of, what is other than knowledge. The fused phrase also pivots the sentence from action to support inventory, then lands the first deprivation in the closed nasal cadence of knowledge.

topics.headline: lack attached as manner and instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ignorance is not background; it is the condition and effective tool of the disputation.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the privative noun and attaches the phrase to the disputing verb.

topics.headline: fused phrase pivots to support inventory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sentence pivot from the act of arguing to the inventory of missing warrants.
topics.reason: The proclitic preposition fuses to the privative noun and scopes over the first support phrase.

topics.headline: nasal landing of first deprivation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first deprivation land with a closed nasal cadence after the light prepositional onset.
topics.reason: The sound row adds a perceptible local cadence tied to the first negated support.

words.gloss_range: construct noun of other-than/without, governed by the proclitic and governing the first denied support while opening the wider privation sequence
words.root_gloss_range: otherness, difference, change, substitution, and alteration range; locally selected as privative other-than rather than verbal alteration
words.prose: {{ar:غَيْرِ}} ({{tr:ghayri}}) is both governed and governing: it is drawn under the preceding preposition and then governs the first excluded support. Its sense is not empty absence only; other-than pressure makes the argument proceed with a substitute condition other than knowledge. The claim that it directly governs the whole later triad must be narrowed, because the following repeated negations give guidance and book their own separate denial beats. The same privative construction marks epistemic void here and moral violation later (22:40), while the rough guttural onset makes the turn into negated support audible.

topics.headline: construct head over first support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first lack is tightly built as a governed construct phrase, while later items are extended by separate negations.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence shows the word as governed by the preposition and as construct head over knowledge; the row extending its governance over the whole triad is narrowed by the repeated negation structure.

topics.headline: absence as other-than substitution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the privation as an active other-than state, not merely a blank space.
topics.reason: The noun's local privative sense supports otherness and substitution pressure without turning into a verbal alteration event.

topics.headline: hinge into three blocked warrants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the word open an ordered inventory of missing supports: knowledge, guidance, and illuminating book.
topics.reason: The word initiates the support inventory, and the subsequent coordinated negatives preserve each support as distinct.

topics.headline: privation formula and rough onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect this privative construction with same-surah formulaic uses such as the epistemic void of 22:8 and the moral violation of 22:40.
topics.reason: The formula recurs in the surah with different complements; the sound row gives the local pivot an audible rough entry.

words.gloss_range: indefinite knowledge as the first denied epistemic resource, not a person who knows
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, marking, signs, teaching, informing, and learning range; locally selected as warranted knowledge or reliable cognition
words.prose: {{ar:عِلْمٍ}} ({{tr:ʿilmin}}) names the first missing warrant. As an indefinite verbal noun under privation, it denies relevant knowledge itself rather than a particular knower. The root field lets knowledge feel like reliable marking and reality-corresponding cognition, so the disputant lacks both inward grasp and transmitted instruction before arguing. At the boundary from 22:7, objective certainty gives way to failed human cognition, and the final nasal cadence links the first denied source to the closing qualifier.

topics.headline: any relevant knowledge denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lack is not one missing datum but the absence of relevant knowledge as a warrant.
topics.reason: The word is indefinite and genitive as the complement of the privative construct.

topics.headline: reliable marks and transmitted knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels knowledge as warranted contact with reality and reliable marks, not mere schooling or opinion.
topics.reason: The local noun selects knowledge; landmark and teaching-learning branches survive as lexical pressure on what kind of warrant is missing.

topics.headline: knowledge resource, not knower form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah deny the resource or state of knowledge rather than identifying a missing knowledgeable person.
topics.reason: The form is a verbal noun, not an active participle.

topics.headline: first item in local epistemic triad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks knowledge as the first support in a triad that moves toward guidance and illuminating book.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and same-surah profiles mark knowledge as a repeated epistemic thread, here appearing as denied.

topics.headline: certainty handed to denied cognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first denied source as part of the final cadence and sees objective certainty give way to failed human reception.
topics.reason: Boundary and sound rows both attach the word to the ayah's transition from certainty to unsupported dispute.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that fuses with negation to add a second independent nor-unit
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) begins the second denial beat. Joined with the following negator, it changes simple addition into nor-force, so guidance is not a gloss on knowledge but a separate absent warrant with its own place in the triad. The repeated connector-negator onset also makes the triad audible as a sequence of distinct losses.

topics.headline: new denial after knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices guidance entering as a separate denied source, not as a mere restatement of knowledge.
topics.reason: The connector plus following negator coordinates the second item in the negative series.

topics.headline: audible second beat in triad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated nor pattern build the triad as a sequence of distinct losses.
topics.reason: The local repetition of the connector-negator shape creates a refrain across the support inventory.

words.gloss_range: negative particle giving guidance its own explicit scope within the coordinated absence chain
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) reopens negation so guidance has its own explicit scope. The repeated particle keeps the second and third supports parallel and prevents the guidance term from being swallowed by the first privative phrase. Its repeated sound gives the final two supports a paired audible denial before their different meanings are parsed.

topics.headline: guidance negated in its own scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices guidance as an independent missing warrant with evaluative force.
topics.reason: The negative particle directly scopes over the following indefinite guidance noun.

topics.headline: parallel denial with final book phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the repeated negation keep guidance and book balanced as separate excluded supports.
topics.reason: The two explicit negative clauses coordinate the final supports in the chain.

topics.headline: paired audible denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated negator as cadence across the last two sources.
topics.reason: The sound row is anchored to the repeated local particle before the second and third supports.

words.gloss_range: indefinite guidance or directional orientation as the second denied epistemic support
words.root_gloss_range: guiding, being guided, route-leading, wayfinding, and sacrificial leading range; locally selected as guidance/orientation rather than a guide-person
words.prose: {{ar:هُدًۭى}} ({{tr:hudan}}) is the second missing support and is not a duplicate of knowledge. It names directional orientation, the knowing-how of being led or finding a way, and the verbal-noun form denies guidance itself rather than a particular guide. Its case-role pressure can be read within the preceding chain or under the repeated negation, but either way the ayah gives guidance its own absence. The contrast with 22:54 sharpens this: the disputant lacks the guidance-linked knowing later given to another group. Its indefinite ending also binds it into the final nominal cadence while preserving its separate lexical role.

topics.headline: guidance denied with live case pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is denied as a class, while its case relation remains tied to both the privative chain and the repeated negation.
topics.reason: The grammar reports genitive-by-proximity or accusative-under-negation pressure; the local payoff is independent denial of guidance without overfixing the case.

topics.headline: orientation beyond propositional knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes missing orientation from missing information: the disputant lacks direction and wayfinding.
topics.reason: The local noun means guidance; route-leading and sacrificial-leading pressures sharpen orientation without replacing the selected sense.

topics.headline: guidance content, not guide-person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah deny guidance itself rather than the presence of a specific guide.
topics.reason: The word is a verbal noun rather than a guide participle.

topics.headline: middle support in knowledge-guidance-book chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks guidance as the middle of the epistemic triad and as a negative node contrasted with the guided-knowing group in 22:54.
topics.reason: The local co-occurrence profile links guidance with knowledge and book, and the row gives the concrete 22:54 contrast.

topics.headline: surah guidance thread and tanwīn binding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears guidance bound into the final nominal cadence while seeing it as part of a larger surah-local guidance thread.
topics.reason: The sound row and recurrence profile both support guidance as a marked node in the ayah's support inventory.

words.gloss_range: connector adding the third and final nor-unit, initiating the longest denied support
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the final denial unit. Because the following book phrase receives an adjective, this connector does more than continue the list: it opens the longest and climactic support in the triad. The repeated nor-shape creates an audible rung before the ascent to the book-plus-adjective close.

topics.headline: third distinct nor-item
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final book phrase as a third distinct denied support, not as subordinate to guidance.
topics.reason: The connector and following negation coordinate the third item in the negative series.

topics.headline: final and longest denial beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated nor pattern climb into the longer book-plus-adjective close.
topics.reason: The final unit is longer because the book receives a qualifying adjective.

words.gloss_range: final negator scoping over the book-plus-illuminating-adjective unit
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates the final phrase as a unit: not merely a book-token, but an illuminating book. The last negation closes the list of missing credentials by excluding clarifying written authority and landing the ayah on the absent written-light source.

topics.headline: negation covers qualified book
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the absence concerns the whole category of illuminating written authority, not any book in isolation.
topics.reason: The negator precedes a noun-adjective unit, and agreement evidence ties the adjective to the book.

topics.headline: final warrant excluded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final negator close the inventory on missing clarifying textual warrant.
topics.reason: The coordinated negation closes the chain of missing supports.

words.gloss_range: indefinite authoritative written record as the third denied support, narrowed by the illuminating adjective
words.root_gloss_range: writing, inscription, prescribing, decree, record, and gathered/joined fixation range; locally selected as fixed textual authority
words.prose: {{ar:كِتَٰبٍ}} ({{tr:kitābin}}) completes the triad as written or textual authority. Its indefiniteness under negation denies any qualifying record of this kind, and the following adjective narrows the missing support to an illuminating book. The root family of writing, prescription, record, and gathered fixation makes the absent warrant feel fixed and binding, the opposite of unsupported twisting argument. The phrase also belongs to a recognizable formula of illuminating book in 22:8, 31:20, and 35:25, and the later mention of a book in 22:70 answers the absence locally. The paired indefinite endings make the book-adjective close land as one unit.

topics.headline: any illuminating book denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the missing support is not any text whatever but any book that qualifies as illuminating.
topics.reason: Agreement and indefiniteness lock the adjective to the book and keep the negated category broad but qualified.

topics.headline: fixed written warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels book as fixed authoritative record, not a casual writing token.
topics.reason: The epistemic triad and root family select authoritative written record or warrant as the local range.

topics.headline: gathered and bound record image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the absent authority as gathered and fixed, while the local sense remains book or record.
topics.reason: The stitching or joining dispute survives as image pressure; it does not replace the selected textual-authority sense.

topics.headline: textual authority as climactic support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the list move from knowledge to guidance to textual authority, with the longest item closing the inventory.
topics.reason: The book phrase is third in the negative series and alone receives an adjective.

topics.headline: recognizable clarifying-text formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as more than generic book language: an illuminating text formula appearing in 22:8, 31:20, and 35:25.
topics.reason: The supplied evidence marks the phrase as a recurring formula tied to clarifying textual authority.

topics.headline: answered by later book and closed by cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can set the absent illuminating book here against the later affirmed book in 22:70 while hearing the noun-adjective ending as one unit.
topics.reason: The rows give the concrete 22:70 contrast and the local sound pairing.

topics.headline: common root made specific by modifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the common book-root becomes marked here through its illuminating qualifier.
topics.reason: The rarity belongs to the qualified phrase, not to the root alone.

words.gloss_range: active Form IV participle qualifying the book as light-giving and clarifying, not passively lit
words.root_gloss_range: light, illumination, radiance, and fire-related range; locally selected as beneficial active illumination for textual clarity
words.prose: {{ar:مُّنِيرٍ}} ({{tr:munīrin}}) is the final adjective and it restricts the missing book. Its Form IV active participle shape makes the book an illuminator, a source that causes clarity to issue, rather than a passive object that happens to be bright. The wider light-and-fire root field is narrowed here to beneficial textual illumination, with later same-surah fire imagery functioning as contrast rather than local sense (22:19; 22:72), and the ayah ends on that absent clarifying force. The modifier also belongs to the formulaic book pairing in 22:8, 31:20, and 35:25. Its doubled opening consonant and long final cadence make the closing illumination-word acoustically prominent.

topics.headline: adjective locked to book
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that illumination is not decorative; it defines the kind of book being denied.
topics.reason: Agreement in case and indefiniteness makes the participle the adjective of the book.

topics.headline: active light-giving clarification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the absent source as actively enlightening, not merely bright.
topics.reason: The Form IV active participle supports causative illumination and active clarification.

topics.headline: light rather than combustion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the root energy channeled into textual radiance, while fire and combustion remain contrastive background.
topics.reason: The n-w-r field includes fire-related terms, but the local adjective of book selects illumination and clarification.

topics.headline: clarifying good absent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lack is evaluative: the disputant lacks a good clarifying source.
topics.reason: The active-participle modifier casts the book as a positive source of clarification.

topics.headline: marked formulaic modifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the modifier as part of a constrained phrase formula in 22:8, 31:20, and 35:25, not generic brightness.
topics.reason: The supplied evidence marks the participle and book pairing as a small formulaic field.

topics.headline: final word lands on absent light
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah close not on argument but on the missing active illumination that would have clarified it.
topics.reason: Final position, morphology, and root image converge in the closing word.

topics.headline: beneficial light before later fire field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can contrast this beneficial illumination with later same-surah fire imagery at 22:19 and 22:72 without making fire the local sense.
topics.reason: The row gives concrete same-surah fire references; they function as contrast, not local activation.

topics.headline: audible closing pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final adjective bind the triad through indefinite endings and a lingering closing sound.
topics.reason: The sound rows are tied to the final local form and its position.

topics.headline: rare active participle choice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the markedness of this active participle within a common light root.
topics.reason: The row distinguishes common root frequency from the smaller supplied active-participle count.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَابٍ مُنِيرٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: The adversarial back-and-forth is deprived of three nonredundant checks: disclosed apprehension, route-giving direction, and written testimony that emits light. The repeated negation leaves the speech unsupported at the levels of cognition, orientation, and record.

activation_trace.role: Wrapped verbal contention supplies the adversarial motion being diagnosed.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the first missing cognitive check.
Gentle direction to road and truth supplies the second missing orienting check.
Ordered letters and the written artifact supply the absent documentary check.
Radiance makes the missing book disclosive rather than merely extant.

changed_reading.before: A person argues about God while ignorant.
changed_reading.after: The ayah diagnoses a dispute operating without any of three distinct correctives: apprehended truth, a route toward it, and an inspectable record that makes it visible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The tightly formed يُجَادِلُ stands beside the absent علم, هدى, and كتاب منير.
baseline_models.mechanism: A dispute can be tightly braided and internally coherent while lacking an external mark, a leading direction, and a beacon. The focus therefore distinguishes argumentative construction from warranted orientation; verbal tightness can counterfeit evidential strength.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting supplies the image of an argument whose strands hold together.
A distinguishing mark supplies the absent external checkpoint.
A leader or foremost element supplies the absent directional front.
Joining one thing to another supplies a rival form of coherence that a true record would discipline.
A visible waymark or beacon supplies the absent public orientation.

changed_reading.before: The uninformed argument is loose or poorly assembled.
changed_reading.after: The argument may be impressively tight; its defect is that internal coherence has been mistaken for a marked, led, and illuminated route to truth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The social subject مِنَ النَّاسِ uses يُجَادِلُ about the object of worship.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dispute branch that throws a person onto hard ground activates a contest model: God-talk has become a social technique for putting an opponent down. The three absent warrants cease to be resources for discovery because the operative goal is positional defeat.

activation_trace.role: Human appearance in a social class supplies the arena in which the contest is staged.
Throwing a person down supplies defeat, rather than inquiry, as the dispute's functional aim.
Worship and the worshipped supply the high-stakes object converted into contest material.

changed_reading.before: The person exchanges claims about God without evidence.
changed_reading.after: The person turns discourse about worship into an opponent-toppling practice, so evidence, direction, and illumination are structurally irrelevant to the chosen aim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-duplicate in 22:3 adds that the unsupported disputant follows every rebel stripped of good; 22:4 then joins alliance to a written consequence, misdirection, and direction toward punishment. The missing guidance in 22:8 is therefore not an empty space but a position occupied by a counter-guide and a substitute chain of allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Verbal contention anchors the context sequence back to the focus act.
Following behind supplies the dependency hidden beneath apparently autonomous argument.
The overreaching rebel supplies the alternative leader being followed.
Being stripped of good until insolent specifies the counter-guide's operating quality.
A binding written determination supplies consequence even where an illuminating book is absent.
Loyal attachment supplies the relational bond that converts following into allegiance.
Departure from guidance and intended direction supplies the first outcome of that allegiance.
A directed course supplies the grim anti-guidance that fills the apparent vacuum.

structural_cues: 22:3 repeats the focus clause through بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ before adding the following relation.
22:4 immediately sequences written consequence, alliance, misdirection, and direction to punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical echo and the following-alliance-direction sequence; I infer that absent warranted guidance permits a counter-guide to occupy its role; a live alternative is that the verses merely juxtapose traits without making substitution causal.

changed_reading.after: The disputant is already being guided in reverse: unsupported argument presents itself as independent reasoning while relaying an allegiance-driven counter-direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation gives the disputant a body that folds and turns its side away, with the stated purpose of misdirecting from an extended path. This turns the focus's tightly twisted جدل into an embodied rhetoric: the speech coils because the speaker's orientation is bent, and its social output is to bend others off route.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting supplies the verbal geometry that the next ayah embodies.
Direction and course supply the orienting dimension negated in the focus.
Folding, bending, and turning supply the speaker's bodily torsion.
Turning the side in aversion gives that torsion a resistant posture.
Departure from intended direction supplies the effect imposed on others.
An extended traversable road supplies the route from which the rhetoric diverts.

structural_cues: 22:9 directly follows the focus with a participial bodily description.
The purpose construction لِيُضِلَّ links the turned posture to diversion from the path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate sequence, bodily turning, and a purpose of misdirection; I align that torsion with the tight-twist branch of جدل; a live alternative is that the posture marks pride while leaving the speech's internal mechanics unspecified.

changed_reading.before: The speaker lacks correct direction while arguing.
changed_reading.after: The argument is a directional technology: inward aversion becomes tightly turned speech that actively rotates hearers away from a traversable path.

context_deltas.mechanism: Travel through the earth is supposed to produce hearts that restrain ignorance, while blindness is relocated from eyes to hearts. Later, knowledge of truth passes into trust, a heart lowered like tranquil ground, and guidance onto a straight path. علم, هدى, and illuminating disclosure in the focus are thus stages of an embodied epistemic process rather than three synonyms for information.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower anchors the cognitive stage of the process.
Gentle direction anchors the process's movement from recognition into route.
Illumination anchors the visibility required for recognition.
Going and traversing supply encounter with evidence as the process's input.
The heart supplies the inner organ in which encountered evidence must become discernment.
Reason as a restraint against ignorance supplies disciplined uptake rather than data accumulation.
Blindness of heart supplies the failure mode despite intact outward sight.
Recognized knowledge supplies the explicit transition from disclosure to response.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what knowledge recognizes.
Low tranquil ground supplies the heart's receptive settling after recognition.
Gentle direction supplies the onward movement that knowledge alone does not complete.
The straight road supplies the concrete orientation produced by guidance.
Uprightness and balanced straightness specify the path's stable form.

structural_cues: 22:46 explicitly contrasts intact eyes with blind hearts after commanding travel through the earth.
22:54 sequences knowing truth, trusting it, the heart's lowering, and guidance to a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the bodily organs and the ordered response sequence; I infer a process linking encounter, restraint, recognition, receptivity, and direction; a live alternative is that these are parallel virtues rather than stages in one epistemic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The disputant lacks three kinds of evidence.
changed_reading.after: The disputant has failed an entire truth-forming process: outward encounter has not become inward restraint, recognized reality, receptive settling, or straight movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recitation sequence in 22:52 permits alien material to be cast into transmission, then removes it and makes the signs firm. Against that sequence, an illuminating book is not just stored content; it is a stabilized disclosure able to distinguish intrusive casting from a confirmed sign. The focus disputant lacks this correction-and-confirmation discipline.

activation_trace.role: The written artifact anchors the transmission whose integrity is at issue.
Illumination anchors the record's capacity to expose rather than conceal intrusion.
Recitation placed in sequence supplies the transmission channel.
Casting something down supplies the intrusive insertion and its repeated identification.
The overreaching rebel supplies the agent of contaminating insertion.
Removal followed by replacement supplies the correction stage.
Firm exactness supplies the confirmation and stabilization stage.
A manifest sign supplies the unit made firm and publicly recognizable.
Knowledge of what is disclosed supplies oversight of the correction process.

structural_cues: 22:52 repeats the casting agent and the cast material before sequencing removal and confirmation.
The corrected objects are the signs, linking textual transmission to manifest evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, insertion, removal, and firming; I infer that كتاب منير names a disclosure with analogous integrity controls; a live alternative is that 22:52 concerns prophetic recitation specifically and should not be generalized into a textual method.

changed_reading.before: The disputant lacks a scripture that could provide evidence.
changed_reading.after: The disputant lacks a stabilized and self-disclosing record by which borrowed, intrusive, or merely cast material can be separated from a confirmed sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late sequence supplies a protocol for not being captured by contention: continue the call from straight guidance, answer renewed dispute with a bounded statement of superior knowledge, defer final separation to judgment, and refer the whole matter to a comprehensive book. The focus person's lack is therefore procedural as well as evidential; the dispute has no principled stopping rule.

activation_trace.role: Revisiting speech and contest anchors the later response protocol to the focus behavior.
Mutual pulling between sides supplies contention as an attempt to capture the addressee.
Calling by speech supplies the positive action that continues without entering the pull.
Direction to truth supplies the caller's maintained orientation.
Balanced straightness supplies the route's resistance to lateral pulling.
The exact return of verbal contention supplies the test case for the protocol.
A concise utterance supplies the bounded response rather than an endless counter-braid.
Knowledge disclosed to the knower supplies the authority to which the bounded answer refers.
Judgment between parties supplies final separation outside the disputants' contest.
Comprehensive knowing supplies the scope that no human dispute can reproduce.
The written record supplies a comprehensive reference beyond improvised claims.
Ease after difficulty supplies the non-anxious closure made possible by that knowledge and record.

structural_cues: 22:67-70 forms an uninterrupted sequence from attempted contention to call, bounded answer, judgment, knowledge, and book.
22:68 repeats the focus root جدل, while 22:70 repeats both علم and كتاب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the direct lexical returns and ordered instructions; I infer that they constitute a stopping protocol contrasting with 22:8; a live alternative is that the sequence governs one ritual dispute without diagnosing disputation in general.

changed_reading.before: The focus dispute lacks enough evidence to reach the right conclusion.
changed_reading.after: The focus dispute also lacks governance: no straight stance, bounded answer, deferred judge, or authoritative record tells it when and how to stop.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:71 nearly restates the focus's God-centered lack as worship without descended compelling warrant and without knowledge. The next ayah presents clear recited signs yet a visibly hostile response that nearly becomes assault. The focus's repeated 'without' can therefore name refusal or bypass of available warrant, not only innocent non-possession.

activation_trace.role: Worship and the worshipped anchor the evidential failure to God-directed commitment.
Disclosure to a knower anchors the warrant explicitly missing in both passages.
The written artifact anchors the kind of transmissible warrant the clear recitation can supply.
Submissive worship supplies the commitment being made without warrant.
Delivery from above supplies the absent authorization's source and direction.
Compelling proof supplies the explicit warrant not sent for the worship.
Disclosed knowledge supplies the second explicit warrant denied to the worshippers.
Following in vocal succession supplies the public presentation of the signs.
Manifest signs supply evidence that is present rather than unavailable.
Manifest appearance supplies the signs' clarity.
Recognition by a visible mark supplies the legibility of the hostile response.
Approaching an act supplies the transition from evidential refusal toward force.

structural_cues: 22:71 combines worship, no descended authority, and no knowledge in one construction.
22:72 moves from clear recited signs to a response whose faces are legible and whose violence is nearly enacted; the branchless س ط و occurrence supports the assault detail.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent warrants followed by present clear signs and near violence; I infer that some lack is maintained by refusal rather than circumstance; a live alternative is that 22:8 and 22:71 describe simple ignorance while 22:72 introduces a different group.

changed_reading.before: The disputant happens not to possess knowledge, guidance, or an illuminating book.
changed_reading.after: The disputant's 'without' may be an enacted bypass of warrant: commitment and contest continue precisely by refusing what could authorize, correct, or expose them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing diagnosis that they did not measure God with His true measure gives the focus's فِي اللَّهِ a scale problem. Speech has exceeded its measuring capacity: without knowledge, direction, or illuminating record, the argument cannot keep its claims proportioned to their object.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped object anchors the question of whether discourse is proportioned to God.
Disclosed knowledge supplies a missing constraint on the scale of claims.
The measure by which a thing reaches its limit supplies proportional judgment as the failed operation.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the standard the measure should match.

structural_cues: 22:74 repeats اللَّه twice and encloses the true measure between the two occurrences.
The diagnosis follows the unsupported worship and hostile reception sequence of 22:71-73.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a failed true measure after unsupported God-directed acts; I infer that the focus dispute is rhetorically over-scale; a live alternative is that 22:74 condemns worship alone rather than the proportions of speech.

changed_reading.before: The argument reaches an incorrect proposition about God.
changed_reading.after: The argument is unauthorized measurement: it speaks at a scale its absent knowledge, direction, and record cannot responsibly bound.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps epistemic nouns into an ecological cycle; it remains anchored because the focus inventories themselves include علم as gathered water and نور as blossom, while 22:5 and 22:63 supply water-to-growth sequences. Downstream prose should mark this as a material resonance, not claim that علم or منير lexically means vegetation here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus lacks علم and ends with a book characterized by منير.

activation_trace.role: A large gathered body of water supplies latent epistemic reserve.
Joining one thing to another supplies an organized bed in which growth could cohere.
Tree blossom supplies visible fruiting as the absent endpoint.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the activating input to dead ground.
Earth and plant stirring with life supply the first responsive motion.
Nourishment and growth supply expansion after activation.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies produced rather than merely agitated discourse.
Fresh beauty supplies the cycle's inspectable fruit.
A second delivered-water scene confirms the recurrent activating input.
Tender green growth supplies visible vitality as the recurrent outcome.

changed_reading.before: The dispute is active speech with too little information.
changed_reading.after: The dispute is sterile activity: it shakes verbally but has no reservoir, cultivated joining, or illumination capable of germinating into visible truth-bearing fruit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant sacrificial هدي branch beneath focus هدى; it remains valid as a resonance because that branch is in the focus inventory and the surah's rite sequence names sacrifice, offered camels, and what reaches God. Downstream prose should retain the ordinary guidance sense and present the offering sense only as a pilgrimage-charged undertone.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus says وَلَا هُدًى inside a surah whose ritual sequence repeatedly materializes approach and offering.

activation_trace.role: The offering carried to the sanctuary supplies a latent sense of costly approach.
Verbal contention supplies the disembodied practice contrasted with offering.
Sacrificial offering supplies the surah's explicit ritual mode of approach.
The offered camel supplies a costly body rather than a merely verbal claim.
A marked ritual sign supplies public embodiment of committed approach.
Reaching and attaining supply the question of what an offering actually delivers.
Placing oneself in protection supplies inward commitment as what reaches beyond flesh and blood.
Direction to truth reconnects the ritual resonance to the focus word's primary orienting force.

changed_reading.before: The disputant approaches God-talk without guidance.
changed_reading.after: The disputant also approaches with nothing offered: no costly embodied submission, protective commitment, or directed gift interrupts the self-sufficient verbal contest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it places illumination and fire on two branches of the same ن و ر inventory; it remains anchored by focus منير and context نار after litigants and after near-assault against reciters. Downstream prose must frame this as a contrast between stable disclosure and destructive heat, never as a claim that منير means fire in 22:8.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The absent كِتَابٍ مُنِيرٍ joins a written carrier to the radiance branch of ن و ر.

activation_trace.role: The written carrier supplies a stable medium for illumination.
Radiance supplies disclosure as the focus's positive light pole.
Contention between opponents supplies the conflict setting adjacent to the first fire image.
Kindled fire supplies destructive luminosity after the two-party conflict.
Manifest signs supply disclosure presented before the hostile reaction.
Approaching violent action supplies the conversion of resisted disclosure into heat.
Kindled fire supplies the destructive pole named after the near-assault sequence.

changed_reading.before: An illuminating book would add more light to the debate.
changed_reading.after: An illuminating book would discriminate light from heat: without a stable written carrier, the intensity generated by conflict can masquerade as disclosure while tending toward combustion.

strongest_changes: 22:3-4 turns absent guidance into active counter-guidance through following, allegiance, misdirection, and a binding consequence.
22:9 gives disputation a bodily geometry in which turned posture becomes tightly turned speech that diverts others.
22:46 and 22:54 turn knowledge, illumination, and guidance into an embodied process from encounter through heart-level discernment to straight movement.
22:67-70 supplies the missing procedural controls: a straight stance, bounded answer, deferred judgment, and comprehensive record.
22:71-72 makes it possible to read 'without' as refusal of available warrant rather than innocent lack alone.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed both direct lexical recurrences and material domains that a local reading would miss: the opening counter-guide returns as a late dispute protocol, while pilgrimage offering, rain-growth, and light-fire contrasts activate contained secondary readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The counter-guidance and turned-body readings depend on taking 22:3-4 and 22:9 as deliberate expansions of the focus's disputant.
The correction mechanism in 22:52 may belong specifically to prophetic recitation rather than to every illuminating book.
The scope of كتاب remains live between revealed textual witness and the comprehensive register in 22:70.
The ecological, sacrificial, and light-fire models are packet-anchored resonances, not replacements for the ordinary lexical reading.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Three absent controls on contention.** `ج د ل B002/B001` is contentious, interlacing argument; `ه د ي B001/B002` supplies guidance and intended direction; `ك ت ب B002` a written book; and `ن و ر B001` illumination. The three coordinated negations remove knowledge, route, and visible document. I infer that valid disputation requires internal grasp, directional orientation, or an external illuminating record. The verse reads diagnostically: the argument is uncontrolled at every epistemic level.
2. **An illuminating book as route-marker.** `ن و ر B005` includes beacon and road landmark, while guidance supplies the course. Their adjacency assigns the book a navigational role. I infer that disclosure makes the traversable way visible. *Kitābin munīr* can therefore be read not only as informative text but as a public marker that prevents argumentative wandering.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:16 later supplied the positive counterpart to the three absences: descended, clarified signs become the medium through which guidance establishes a route.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Argument deprived of three orienting controls.** Fixed `يُجَٰدِل` retains `ج د ل:B001` (twisting and interlacing) and `B002` (contentious disputation). The three coordinated negations remove `ع ل م:B001` (clear knowing), `ه د ي:B001` (guidance toward a way), and `ك ت ب:B002` (joined letters in a written book); `مُّنِير` adds `ن و ر:B001` (illumination). `22:9` then shows the arguer bodily turning aside and diverting a path. I infer that these absent controls would otherwise keep linked claims aligned. The reading changes from generic ignorance to an argument-system with no evidence, direction, record, or light.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `22:9` was the retrospective surprise: the missing epistemic controls become a visibly bent flank and a diverted road, converting an abstract defect in argument into embodied orientation.

baseline.text: İnsanlardan kimi, bilgisi, yol göstereni ve aydınlatıcı bir kitabı olmadan Allah hakkında tartışır.

findings.text: Bu tartışma bilgi, yön ve aydınlatıcı kayıt biçimindeki üç denetimden de yoksun olduğu için birbirine dolanan iddiaları doğrultamaz.
Aydınlatıcı kitap, yalnız bilgi veren bir metin değil, tartışmanın yoldan çıkmasını önleyen görünür bir güzergâh işaretidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısındaki insan türünü, bu türün topluluğunu ve tek bir üyesini birlikte gösterir. Görünür olma açıklaması adlandırma gerekçesidir; insan olmanın kurucu tanımı değildir. Evde kimsenin bulunmadığını bildiren kalıp ise dal çekirdeğine genellenemez ve yalnızca kendi sözcüksel biriminde korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, insan türünü ve onun tekil ya da toplu üyelerini kapsar; yakınlık duygusunu, duyusal algıyı ve insana dönük yanı kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçimlerdeki insan ve insan topluluğu anlamı dal çekirdeğidir; evde hiç kimse bulunmadığını anlatan kalıp ayrı tutulur ve çekirdeğe yeni bir genel anlam katmaz.

concept_map.definition: Görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısında yer alan insan türünü, bu türün topluluğunu ya da tek bir üyesini belirtir. İnsanların görünür oluşu, bu adlandırma için aktarılan bir gerekçedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarılan anlam alanının merkezi görüp fark etmektir. Aynı ifade ailesi belirli nesne ve yapılarda işitme, bir belirtiyi anlayıp ayırt etme, kaygı veren şeyi sezme ve bakıp araştırma yönlerinde kullanılır; bunlar sınırsız bir genel algı anlamı oluşturmaz.

concept_gloss.text: görerek fark etme; bağlama göre işitme, sezme ve bakıp araştırma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın görme çekirdeğiyle birlikte yalnız belirtilen bağlamlarda ortaya çıkan işitme, sezme ve çevreyi araştırma uzantılarını topluca verir.

error_profile.preserves: Görme çekirdeğini ve bağlama bağlı üç algısal uzantıyı ayrı olduklarını belirterek korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nesnenin gözle seçildiği veya görüldüğü temel kullanımda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Gözle görme ve görüleni fark etme işlemlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nesne açıkça bir ses olduğunda kullanılan bağlama bağlı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin kulakla algılanması biçimindeki özel kullanımı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsedeki olgunluk veya kaygı uyandıran durum gibi bir belirtinin ayırt edildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Duyusal belirtiden bir durumun varlığını anlayıp ayırt etmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çevreyi gözleyip birinin bulunup bulunmadığını anlamaya çalışma kullanımında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dikkatle bakma ile birini bulmaya yönelik araştırmayı birlikte korur.

error_profile.preserves: Bir kişi veya şeye yönelen deneyim fikrini çok genel biçimde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, görmenin yanında belirli yapılarda işitme, belirti sezme ve çevreyi araştırma uzantılarını taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal görmeyi merkez alır ve yalnız belirli söz çevrelerinde işitme, sezme ve araştırmaya uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu daha genel bir duyu alanıdır; odak dalın uzantıları ise kanıtlanan nesne ve yapılara bağlıdır. Bu nedenle genel duyumsama her durumda odak ifadeyle karşılanamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bir nesneyi görme, işitme veya belirtilerinden sezme eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir kişi ya da şey karşısında yabancılık ve ürkme duymayıp yakınlık hissetmeyi anlatır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آنس الشيء إذا أبصره أو رآه، وآنس الصوت إذا سمعه، وأحس الفزع أو وجد الشيء في نفسه، والاستئناس بمعنى النظر والتبصر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل الأنس بمعنى الراحة والمؤالفة ولا الإنس بمعنى البشر إلا بقرينة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: آنست الشيء إذا رأيته وآنسته إذا سمعته (maqayis)؛ آنسته أبصرته وآنست الصوت سمعته وآنست منه رشدا علمته (sihah)؛ آنس من جانب يعني أبصر نارا والاستئناس النظر وأحس بما رابه (tahdhib)؛ فإن آنستم منهم رشدا أي أبصرتم وآنست نارا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişi veya şey karşısında yabancılık ve ürkme duygusunun kalkmasını çekirdek anlam olarak verir. Yakınlık ve sevinç, rahatlık veren kişi ya da şey ve insana alışık saldırgan olmayan hayvan kullanımları bu çekirdekten bağımlı biçimde açıklanabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal duygusal yakınlık, rahatlık ve bunları sağlayan varlıkları kapsar; insan türünün adı, duyusal fark etme ve insana bakan yan anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yabancılık duymama çekirdeği ile rahatlık veren kişi veya şey ve insana alışık hayvan gibi özelleşmiş biçimler ayrı katmanlarda tutulur; özel biçimler bütün dalı tanımlamaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi ya da şey karşısında yabancılık, ürkme veya kaçınma duymayıp yakınlık, rahatlık ve sevinç hissetmeyi anlatır. Bu duyguyu veren kişi veya şeye ve insana alışık, saldırgan olmayan hayvana da aktarılır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şey karşısında yabancılık ve ürkme duygusunun kalkıp yakınlık, rahatlık veya sevinç oluşmasını anlatır.
Kişiye arkadaşlık ederek veya yanında bulunarak yabancılık duygusunu gideren kişi ya da şeyi adlandırır.
İnsana alışık ve saldırgan olmayan hayvanı, özellikle bu nitelikteki köpeği anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, yabancılık ve kaçınmanın karşıtı olan yakınlık ve rahatlıktır. Bu durum birine alışıp onun yanında sevinmeyi, rahatlık veren kişi veya şeyi ve insana alışık saldırgan olmayan hayvanı kapsayacak biçimde genişler.

concept_gloss.text: yabancılık duymadan yakınlık ve rahatlık hissetme
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi veya şeyin ürkütücü ve yabancı gelmemesi, tersine yakınlık ve iç rahatlığı vermesi anlatıldığında dalın çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yabancılığın kalkmasıyla oluşan yakınlık ve rahatlık bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi veya şey karşısındaki yabancılık duygusunun kalktığı temel durumda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Alışma sonucunda yabancılığın kalkmasını ve yakınlık oluşmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.text: yanında rahatlık veren kişi veya şey

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın insana alışıklığını ve saldırgan olmama sınırını birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yabancılığın kalkmasıyla doğan duygusal yakınlığı ve rahatlığı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal insan türünü, insan topluluğunu veya bu türden tek bir kişiyi adlandırır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أنس الإنسان بالشيء أو بفلان، المؤانسة والتأنيس، الأنيس وكل ما يؤنس به، الفرح بالقرب والحديث، والحيوان الأنوس غير العقور.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل الإنس بمعنى البشر ولا الإيناس بمعنى الإبصار ولا الجانب الإنسي إلا بدليل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأنس أنس الإنسان بالشيء إذا لم يستوحش منه (maqayis)؛ الإيناس خلاف الإيحاش والإنس خلاف الوحشة والأنيس المؤانس وكل ما يؤنس به (sihah)؛ أنست بفلان أي فرحت به والأنس والاستئناس هو التأنس وكلب أنوس نقيض العقور (tahdhib)؛ الأنس خلاف النفور ولكل ما يؤنس به (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin güvenilir çekirdeği, bir şeyin insana veya onu kullanan kişiye dönük ve yakın olan yanıdır. Bu yanın solda mı sağda mı olduğu konusunda aktarımlar uyuşmaz; hayvan ve yay örnekleri yönü işlevsel ilişkiyle belirler. Bu nedenle sabit bir sağ-sol tanımı dalın özüne konamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir nesnenin insana veya kullanıcıya bakan yanını belirtir; salt sol, salt sağ, genel ön taraf ya da insanın kendisi anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın insana dönük yan çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır. Hayvan ve yay uygulamaları bu çekirdeğin örneklenmesidir; yalnız bu kullanımlardan yeni bir genel yön anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin insana, kullanıcıya veya onun bulunduğu yöne bakan yanıdır. Hayvan ve yay üzerinde işlevsel ilişkiyle belirlenir; bu yanın sabit olarak sol ya da sağ sayılması konusunda aktarım uyuşmazlığı vardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin insana en yakın olan veya insana doğru bakan yanını belirtir.
Hayvanda binicinin bulunduğu, binme ve sağma işlemlerinde insana yakın olan yanı anlatır.
Yayda okçuya doğru bakan ve kullanıcının karşısında bulunan yanı anlatır.
İnsana yakın yan bazı aktarımda sol, başka bir aktarımda sağ diye belirlenir; yönün özü bu değişken tanımlardan bağımsızdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, nesnenin insana veya kullanıcıya dönük yanıdır; hayvanda biniciye, yayda okçuya göre belirlenir. İnsan bedenindeki tekil uygulamada öteki bacağa bakan yan kastedilir. Bu yanın solda mı sağda mı bulunduğuna ilişkin anlatımlar ayrıştığı için genel tanım sabit bir yön seçmez.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin yönü, ona yaklaşan veya onu kullanan insana göre belirlendiğinde dalın ortak çekirdeğini verir.

error_profile.preserves: Yanı sabit sağ veya sola bağlamadan insana göre yönelmiş olmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın binme ve sağma sırasında insana yakın kalan yanı anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın yanını biniciyle kurduğu işlevsel ilişkiye göre belirler.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yayın kullanım sırasında okçuya doğru dönük olan yüzü belirtilirken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yay yüzünün yönünü okçunun konumuna göre belirleme özelliğini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel olarak ön, önde, yakın veya karşıda bulunma yönlerini kişiye bağlı bir kullanım ilişkisi gerektirmeden anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda yön, insanın nesneyle kurduğu konum veya kullanım ilişkisine bağlıdır. Komşu dalın genel ön ve yakın anlamları bu özel bağı gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, yönelme tamamlandıktan sonra insana dönük olan sabit yanı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yüz, baş, el, kap veya hayvanın bir hedefe doğru dönmesi ve yönelmesi eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişi veya hedefe doğru bakma yönünü içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bir nesnenin insana dönük yanı bir bölüm adıdır; komşu ise dönme veya yönelme olayını anlatır. Sonuç konumu ile o konuma geçiş eylemi birbirinin yerine kullanılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal insana veya kullanıcıya yakın ve ona bakan yanı gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyin arkasında kalan, yüzünün karşıtı olan arka bölümünü gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir nesnenin başka bir yöne göre belirlenen bölümünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bağlama göre karşıt görünebilseler de odak dal her zaman geometrik ön yüz değildir ve bu yüzden düzenli bir karşıt çift oluşturmaz; belirleyici ölçüt insana yakınlıktır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı incelendi. Genel ön taraf, yönelme eylemi ve arka bölümle kurulan karşılaştırmalar insana göre belirlenen yanın sınırını en açık biçimde gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسي الدابة والقوس وكل شيئين: ما يلي الإنسان أو يقبل على الراكب أو الرامي، في مقابلة الوحشي.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل الإنسان نفسه ولا الأنس النفسي ولا الإبصار.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الإنسي الأيسر من كل شيء وقيل الأيمن وما أقبل منهما على الإنسان فهو إنسي وإنسي القوس ما أقبل عليك منها (sihah)؛ الإنسي من الدواب الجانب الأيسر الذي منه يركب ويحتلب ومن الإنسان الجانب الذي يلي الرجل الأخرى (tahdhib)؛ إنسي الدابة للجانب الذي يلي الراكب وإنسي القوس للجانب الذي يقبل على الرامي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak çekirdeği, gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Parmak ucu anlamı tek aktarım içinde eklenir ve gözdeki görüntünün kurucu parçası değildir; bağımlı bir kaynak varyantı olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal göz bebeğinde görülen küçük görüntüyü, ayrıca ayrı bir aktarım olarak parmak ucunu kapsar; gözün kendisini veya genel insan türünü belirtmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dalın çekirdeği gözün kara bölümündeki küçük görüntüdür. Parmak ucu aktarımı bağımlı bir varyanttır; gözle ilgili belirli biçimlerden genel görüntü veya genel insan anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Ayrı bir kaynak kullanımında aynı ad parmak ucuna da verilir, ancak bu kullanım göz görüntüsü çekirdeğini değiştirmez.

facets.statement: Göz bebeğinin kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntüyü veya yansımayı adlandırır.
Ayrı bir aktarımda parmak ucu veya eldeki parmak ucunu anlatan kullanım da aynı adla verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak aktarım, göz bebeğinin kara bölümünde görülen küçük görüntüyü bir insan biçimi olarak tanımlar. Buna ek olarak parmak ucu anlamı da bildirilir, fakat bu ek kullanım gözdeki yansıma çekirdeğinden ayrı tutulur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir bakanın göz bebeğinde beliren küçük insan biçimli görüntü adlandırıldığında dalın ortak ve temel anlamını karşılar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki ayrı kalıplaşmış ilişkiyi açıkça ayırır: kişiye kendi durumunu soran sözde kişinin kendisi, bir başkasına bağlanan sözde ise seçilmiş yakın ve sırdaş kastedilir. Yakın arkadaş ve oturup konuşulan kişi için verilen paralel adlar ikinci alanı destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız belirtilen söz kuruluşlarında kişinin kendisini veya seçkin yakınını gösterir; genel insan, gerçek evlatlık ve her türlü arkadaşlık anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kişinin kendisini soran kuruluş, seçilmiş yakını belirten kuruluş ve yakın arkadaş adları ayrı tutulur. Bunların hiçbiri çıplak biçime genel kişi veya akrabalık anlamı olarak taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir soru kuruluşunda muhatabın kendisini ve durumunu, başka bir kişiyle kurulan adlandırmada ise onun seçilmiş yakınını, sırdaşını veya sürekli görüştüğü arkadaşını belirtir. İki kullanım aynı kuruluş ailesinde bulunsa da katılımcı ilişkileri ayrıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye kendi durumunu soran belirli kuruluşta muhatabın kendisini gösterir.
Bir kişiye bağlanarak söylendiğinde onun seçilmiş yakınını, özel arkadaşını veya sırdaşını belirtir.
Aynı anlam çevresindeki paralel adlar yakın dostu, içten arkadaşı ve oturup konuşulan kişiyi gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, doğrudan hitapta kişinin kendi durumunu soran kullanım ile birinin seçkin yakını ve sırdaşını gösteren kullanımı birlikte verir. Yakın dost ve sürekli görüşülen arkadaş anlamındaki paralel adlar ikinci ilişki alanını genişletir.

concept_gloss.text: belirli sözlerde kişinin kendisi veya seçilmiş yakını
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kaynakta gösterilen soru ve kişi bağlantısı kuruluşlarını topluca açıklarken kullanılabilir; genel bir kişi ya da akraba adı değildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız eve giriş öncesindeki belirli söz çevresinde açıklanır. Bir aktarım bunu selam verip izin isteme ve girebilir miyim diye sorma olarak, diğeri ise girişe elverişli bir kabul ve yakınlık bulma olarak yorumlar. Dal bu iki açıklamayı korumalı, fakat çıplak biçime genel bakma veya genel rahatlık anlamı yüklememelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal eve girmeden önce izin ve kabul arama durumuyla sınırlıdır; genel görme, genel yakınlık, eve yerleşme veya barınma anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam çözümlenmemiştir ve eldeki kanıt yalnız giriş öncesi kuruluşu gösterir. Bu nedenle tanım bu söz çevresine bağlanır, çıplak bir genel anlam varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir eve girmeden önce selam vererek izin istemeyi ve içeridekilerin girişe açık olduğunu anlamayı anlatır. Aktarımın bir yönü doğrudan izin sorusunu, diğer yönü girişe elverişli bir kabul ve yakınlık bulmayı öne çıkarır.

facets.statement: Eve girmeden önce selam verip girmek için izin istemeyi ve kabul beklemeyi anlatır.
Ayrı açıklama, girişten önce içeridekilerden yakınlık ve kabul işareti bulmayı öne çıkarır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Giriş öncesi davranış iki yönden açıklanır: selam verip açıkça izin istemek ve girebilir miyim diye sormak ya da içeridekilerden girişe elverişli bir kabul ve yakınlık bulmak. Her iki açıklama da eve izinsiz girmeme sınırında birleşir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yular, kuşak veya zırh gibi parçaları birbirine sıkıca geçirilmiş ürünleri niteler.

error_profile.preserves: Parçaların sıkı biçimde birleştirilmesi ve ürünün sağlamlığı korunur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sıkı bükümün sağlamlaştırıcı sonucunu ve yular ya da zırh gibi örülmüş ürünleri özellikle kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, sıkılık şartı koymadan ip biçiminde bükülen başka nesneleri de kapsayan daha genel bir bükme alanına sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da ipi veya ip benzeri bir şeyi kendi ekseni çevresinde bükme işlemini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda bükümün sıkı ve sağlamlaştırıcı olması belirleyicidir; komşu dalda ise genel bükme biçimi yeterlidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yalnız genel bükme ile sıkı ve sağlamlaştırıcı büküm arasındaki karşıtlık dal sınırını belirginleştirdi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade, sözün karşılıklı olarak sürdürülmesini, çekişme ve üstün gelme amacıyla yürütülen tartışmayı açıkça bir araya getirir. Geçici çerçeve bu sözlü mücadele çekirdeğini doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sıradan görüş alışverişini değil, karşı çıkma ve üstün gelme yönü bulunan çekişmeli konuşmayı anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel sözlü çekişmeyi kişi nitelemeleri ve tartışmada yenme sonucuna bağlı kalıplardan ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Tarafların birbirine karşı çıkarak sözü karşılıklı sürdürdüğü, çekiştiği ve çoğu kez konuşmada üstün gelmeye çalıştığı sözlü mücadeledir.

facets.statement: Taraflar, anlaşmazlık içindeki sözleri karşılıklı olarak ileri sürer ve birbirine cevap verir.
Çekişme, karşı tarafı sözle yenme veya tartışmada üstün gelme amacına kadar yoğunlaşabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, uzayan karşılıklı konuşmayı sıradan tartışmadan ayıran çekişme ve sözle üstün gelme yönünü vurgular.

concept_gloss.applicability: Karşılıklı itiraz, sözün sürdürülmesi ve üstün gelme çabasını birlikte taşıyan konuşmalar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı konuşma, çekişme ve sözle üstün gelme yönlerinin tümü korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki tarafın birbirine karşı çıkarak konuşmayı sürdürdüğü eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı itiraz ve çekişmeli konuşma eylemi korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözlü çekişmenin bir tarafı yenmesiyle sonuçlandığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sözlü mücadele ve karşı tarafı yenme sonucu korunur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal, sözün karşılıklı sürdürülmesini ve konuşmada üstün gelme çabasını çekirdeğe alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, tek kişi ya da topluluk için kullanılan hasım adlarını ve kanıt öğretme gibi daha geniş kullanımları da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da karşıt tarafların birbirine sözle karşı çıkıp mücadele etmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın sınırı karşılıklı söz yürütme ve sözle yenme üzerindedir; komşu dalın kapsamı hasım kimliğine ve daha genel uyuşmazlığa da uzanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; en yararlı ayrım, karşılıklı söz yürütme çekirdeği ile daha geniş hasımlık alanı arasındadır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجدل والجدال والمجادلة ومراجعة الكلام والمنازعة والمغالبة وغلبة الخصم في الكلام
